metadata.scope: The terminal state is an evidence-policy verdict over Zetaris rows. A repository that is not NO_GO also gets a revival PRD with stage revive, refactor, and upgrade. This run does not clone, compile, test, or push commits. With no stage-revive attempt, the row policy still decides and the verdict says revival has not yet been attempted. A stage-revive success on the fork default branch, with an attempt commit and eligible build/test CI, is RESURRECTED and can override an upstream CI failure. It cannot override NO_GO. A stage-revive failure is RESURRECTION_FAILED and cites that run. Refactor and upgrade are an upgrade result and do not change the verdict.
